integrity: All original equations and proof arguments were reconstructed within this package; external prior rates, qubit classifications, spectral criteria and semigroup constructions are attributed to cited authors. Self-review only; no independent certification or external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex mixture of q+1 complete field-line pinching semigroups for q=p^r>=3 with one common positive decay rate; CP-divisibility is in the intermediate-CPTP sense. No claim for arbitrary non-field Weyl maps, unequal constituent rates, time-varying weights or non-CP notions of information backflow.
title: Sharp Markovian simplex and single-onset transition for finite-field Weyl mixtures
